relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Toll-Like Receptor 4 (TLR4) in glial reactivity, sickness behavior, and unwanted opioid effects (tolerance, hyperalgesia)

key_findings: Tribute to Watkins: glia actively participate in pain states; roles of IL-1β, IL-10, CX3CL1 and TLR4 in glial reactivity and opioid side effects.
